name: app-store-preview
title: App Store preview
summary: A 15-to-30-second App Store app preview made only from the app's own screens, sized per device class to Apple's current specs.
use_when: An iOS, iPadOS or Mac app's product page. Apple's rules decide what it may show.

pace.note: Previews play muted by default, so any voice-over is a bonus and the on-screen copy carries the story.

beats.name: open
beats.job: The app's core moment, in the first three seconds, readable without sound.

beats.name: features
beats.job: Two or three things the app does, each in its own real screens with one line of copy.

beats.name: close
beats.job: The app's home or its value in one line; the poster frame is a strong still too.

rules: The poster frame defaults to the frame at five seconds: make that frame worth stopping on, or choose another.
Copy stays on screen long enough to read (the read-time gate checks it).

capture.source: slate capture ios (the Simulator with status-bar overrides, a seeded demo account and a pinned build); slate capture web for a Mac app's web views
capture.principle: Only what the app itself shows: real screen captures, conformed to the film's frame rate. Copy cards and captions may sit around them; the app's interface is never redrawn or invented.
rules: No people, hands or devices: Apple asks for the app's own content only.
Sample data is the demo account's, never a real customer's.

content_rules: App previews must show only content within the app itself; don't film people interacting with a device.
Appropriate for all ages: no violence, adult themes or profanity.
Only material you have the right to show, licensed for marketing in every territory.
No seasonal references and no specific pricing.
Up to three previews per language, each 15 to 30 seconds.

deliver: H.264 in .mov, .m4v or .mp4: 10-12 Mbps, progressive, High Profile Level 4.0 or lower

files.label: App Store preview, H.264
files.note: The middle of Apple's 10-12 Mbps, capped at 12; the delivery's ProRes 422 HQ master is the other accepted form.

encode.audio: Stereo; 256 kbps AAC with H.264, PCM or 256 kbps AAC with ProRes; 44.1 or 48 kHz; every track enabled.
encode.note: Apple's limit is 500 MB; Slate treats it as 500,000,000 bytes to stay under it either way.

loudness.standard: Slate's web target; Apple publishes no loudness target for previews

captions.position: clear of the app's own controls
captions.note: Apple's preview specs list only video and audio tracks, and previews play muted, so any voice-over is captioned in the picture.

budget.note: Generation is off: previews show the app itself.

notes: A hero placement: every device size is a derived film at master quality through the full pipeline.
Apple also lists 1080 x 1920 for 5.5 and 4 inch iPhones, 1920 x 1080 for Apple TV and 3840 x 2160 for Vision Pro (see the app_store channel).

sources.title: App Store Connect Help: App preview specifications
sources.says: H.264 or ProRes 422 (HQ only); 15 to 30 seconds; up to 500 MB; 30 fps maximum; stereo audio at 44.1 or 48 kHz; the resolutions per device; up to 3 previews; the poster frame defaults to 5 seconds.

sources.title: Apple Developer: App previews
sources.says: Show only content within the app itself; previews play muted by default, so use legible on-screen copy; appropriate for all ages; avoid seasonal references and pricing.
